component.name: 可圈office Presentations
可圈office PPT演示
component.summary: Create slide decks for meetings, teaching, and proposals
可圈office 办公套件中的 PPT演示编辑器

description.p: Presentations is the slide editor in 可圈office. It is aimed at reports, teaching materials, pitches, project demos, and meeting decks.
Use it for templates, PDF export, speaker-ready slides, and compatibility with common presentation formats.
PPT演示是可圈office 办公套件中的演示文稿组件，适合制作汇报、课件、项目介绍、 方案演示和会议幻灯片。
它支持模板、PDF 导出，以及常见演示格式的兼容处理。
